name: Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models (arXiv:2404.02258)
notes: arXiv:2404.02258. Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models. By David Raposo et al. (Google DeepMind). Submitted 2024-04-02. Dynamically allocates compute (FLOPs) to different layers based on token importance.
